title: Family Seated Indoors, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th century black and white square snapshot depicting three family members seated together in a living room setup. An older woman on the left wears a striped apron and cardigan, while a gentleman sits in the center wearing a dark tailored suit and wide patterned tie. A younger woman sits to his right holding a small book or card. Lens glare and light exposure artifacts are visible across the top portion of the frame, characteristic of mid-century home photography equipment. The print features scalloped deckled edges.
